title: worktree isolation becomes usable: it carries the environment the project declares, links what is heavy, reports what did not travel, cleans up after itself, and the gate isolates a second unit instead of taking over the checkout

waves.summary: A worktree receives the environment the project declares: small files copied, heavy directories linked, and whatever could not travel is named.
The collector stops reporting and starts collecting — keyed on whether the owner still exists, not on how many days have passed.
A second unit is isolated instead of taking over the checkout, and the prose teaches the arrangement that now actually works.
